data.title: Mussolini's great-grandson scores his first goal for Lazio - Bozeman Daily Chronicle
data.content: # Mussolini's great-grandson scores his first goal for Lazio. ## Romano Floriani Mussolini, the great-grandson of Benito Mussolini, has scored his first goal for Lazio. On Tuesday, the 23-year-old secured Lazio's third goal in a 6-2 win over Sassuolo in Serie A. This marks his first goal in Italy's top division and only the second of his career. Lazio's Romano Floriani Mussolini, rear, scores a goal during the Serie A soccer match between Sassuolo and Lazio in Reggio Emilia, Italy, Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026. Lazio's Romano Floriani Mussolini, right, celebrates with Gustav Isaksen after scoring a goal during the Serie A soccer match between Sassuolo and Lazio in Reggio Emilia, Italy, Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026. SASSUOLO, Italy (AP) — Romano Floriani Mussolini, the great-grandson of former Italian dictator Benito Mussolini, scored his first goal for Lazio on Tuesday. The 23-year-old Floriani Mussolini — who has “Romano” on the back of his jersey — struck in the 16th minute for Lazio’s third goal in its 6-2 rout of Sassuolo in Serie A.

data.title: Preview | Fiorentina vs Juventus Women - Yahoo Sports
data.content: The Women's First Team are back to Serie A action on Monday evening as they travel south to face Fiorentina. * Fiorentina are the team against whom Juventus have won the most matches (24, 2 draws, 7 defeats) across all competitions, including the most recent one in Serie A in early April. * In the 14 matches played between these two sides at Fiorentina's ground across all competitions, there have never been any draws: 10 wins for the Bianconeri and four for the Viola; furthermore, Juve have found the net in 13 of these 14 encounters in Tuscany, scoring a total of 28 goals (an average of exactly two per match). * Fiorentina have won their last three Serie A home matches, keeping two clean sheets in the process: the Tuscan side could win four consecutive home matches in the competition for the first time since August–November 2024 (a run of five on that occasion).
